# Anti-AI-Slop UI/UX Engineering Standard

"AI Slop" refers to the stereotypical, low-effort visual tropes frequently generated by AI models when designing user interfaces. In mission-critical enterprise ERP/CRM software (manufacturing, accounting, print shop operations), AI slop destroys credibility, clutters screens, slows down data entry, and frustrates professional users.

This skill establishes zero tolerance for AI slop across the entire codebase.

---

## 1. The Cardinal Anti-Slop Rules

### 1.1. ABSOLUTELY ZERO EMOJIS IN THE UI
- **Never** render Unicode emojis (`📦`, `🛒`, `👔`, `👷`, `⚠️`, `✅`, `🔥`, `✨`, `💡`, `❌`, `ℹ️`, `🧪`, `🏷️`, `💰`, etc.) inside:
  - Buttons & triggers
  - Dialog titles and headers
  - Badges and status pills
  - Dropdown options and SelectItems
  - Form labels and field placeholders
  - Table / DataGrid cells
- **The Remedy**: Use official, refined **Lucide SVG icons** (`size-3.5` or `size-4`) with semantic coloring, or rely purely on precise typography.

```tsx
// ❌ REJECTED (AI Slop):
<Button>📦 Ombordan tanlash</Button>
<SelectItem value="remake">⚠️ Qayta chiqarish (Remake / Defect)</SelectItem>
<DialogTitle>🛒 Xaridga buyurtma</DialogTitle>

// ✅ REQUIRED (Enterprise Standard):
<Button className="gap-1.5">
  <Warehouse className="size-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
  <span>Ombordan tanlash</span>
</Button>
<SelectItem value="remake">Qayta chiqarish (Remake / Defect)</SelectItem>
<DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
  <ShoppingCart className="size-4 text-primary" />
  <span>Xaridga buyurtma</span>
</DialogTitle>
```

---

### 1.2. NO GRATUITOUS GRADIENTS OR GLOW EFFECTS
- **Never** use colorful gradients (`bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 via-pink-500 to-indigo-500`, `bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-indigo-100`).
- **Never** use colored drop-shadow glows (`shadow-blue-500/50`, `shadow-indigo-500/20`).
- **The Remedy**: High-end enterprise design (Linear, Stripe, Vercel) uses flat, neutral backgrounds (`bg-background`, `bg-card`, `bg-muted/40`) with crisp, subtle 1px border lines (`border-border`).

```tsx
// ❌ REJECTED (AI Slop):
<div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-violet-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30 rounded-xl p-4">

// ✅ REQUIRED (Enterprise Standard):
<div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-lg p-3">
```

---

### 1.3. NO "CARDCEPTION" (OVER-NESTED CARDS)
- **AI Slop Symptom**: Placing a card inside a card inside another card, each with its own borders, padding, and background tints.
- **The Remedy**: Use subtle grid layouts, simple borders, or `Separator` dividers instead of wrapping every 2 inputs in a container box. Flat, structured layouts with high information density.

---

### 1.4. HIGH INFORMATION DENSITY (1C & INDUSTRIAL STANDARD)
- Enterprise operators manage hundreds of items every day. Screen real estate is precious.
- **Form Controls**: Heights must be compact: `h-7` or `h-8`, font `text-xs`.
- **Spacing**: Use `gap-2` to `gap-3`, padding `p-2.5` to `p-3`. Never use bloated `p-6` or `p-8` inside modal dialogs.
- **Typography**: Numerical data, codes, SKU, and prices must use `font-mono font-medium`.

---

### 1.5. RADICAL MINIMALISM: ZERO SUBTITLES, ZERO DESCRIPTIVE PROSE, ZERO PARENTHETICAL TRANSLATIONS
- **AI Slop Symptom 1 (Descriptive Subtitles)**: Adding explanatory `<p>` subtitles under card headers, section titles, or empty states (e.g., *"Texnologik zanjir va smena dispetcherligi — Bosqichlararo qog'oz oqimi, dastgoh holati va smena hisoboti"*). Professional ERP users use the screen 100 times a day; descriptive subtitles are pure visual noise.
- **AI Slop Symptom 2 (Pompous Titles & Parenthetical English)**: Inflating headers and buttons with bilingual parentheticals or buzzwords (e.g., *"Texnologik Zanjir va Smena Dispetcherligi (MES Pipeline)"*, *"Paletlar va Harakatlar Jurnali (Cascade Floor Ledger)"*, *"Ishni Boshlash (Start)"*, *"To'xtatilgan (Paused)"*, *"1. Kirgan Qog'oz (Brutto)"*).
- **The Remedy**:
  - **Zero section subtitles**: Never render descriptive `<p>` text under card/section headers.
  - **1–2 word labels**: Section headers, KPI titles, buttons, and status options must be 1–2 words max (`"Texnologik zanjir"`, `"Smena jurnali"`, `"Kirgan qog'oz"`, `"Jami brak"`, `"Sof chiqish"`, `"Boshlash"`, `"To'xtalish"`, `"Palet kiritish"`).
  - **Zero bilingual parentheticals**: Never append `(Start)`, `(Resume)`, `(Queued)`, `(Paused)`, `(MES Pipeline)`, `(Cascade Floor Ledger)` to UI strings.

```tsx
// ❌ REJECTED (AI Slop — Verbose & Noisy):
<div>
  <div className="text-xs font-bold">
    Texnologik Zanjir va Smena Dispetcherligi (MES Pipeline)
  </div>
  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
    Bosqichlararo qog'oz oqimi (WIP kaskadi), dastgoh holati va smena hisoboti
  </p>
</div>
<Button>Ishni Boshlash (Start)</Button>

// ✅ REQUIRED (Minimalist Enterprise Standard):
<span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Texnologik zanjir</span>
<Button>Boshlash</Button>
```

---

### 1.6. RESTRAINED, SEMANTIC COLOR PALETTE
- Don't paint the screen like a circus. Every color must communicate system status:
  - **Neutral**: Default text, borders, and general elements (`text-foreground`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border-border`).
  - **Primary**: Intentional action buttons (Save, Submit, Open) — standard 1C Blue (`#2563eb`).
  - **Success / In-Stock**: Muted emerald (`text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300`).
  - **Warning / Low Stock**: Muted amber (`text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300`).
  - **Danger / Deficit / Reject**: Muted rose (`text-rose-700 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-300`).
- No rainbow pastel backgrounds, no random purple/cyan buttons.

---

## 2. Anti-Slop Audit Checklist

Before finalizing any UI component or dialog, verify:
- [ ] Are there any emojis in text strings or JSX? -> **Delete them immediately.**
- [ ] Are there gradients or glowing blur shadows? -> **Replace with clean flat border tokens.**
- [ ] Are buttons using standard shadcn `Button` with `size="sm"` or `h-8`?
- [ ] Is information density high and suitable for daily industrial work?
- [ ] Are status badges concise (1-2 words), not paragraphs?
- [ ] Is numerical data formatted in monospace (`font-mono`)?
